guard: Member access reaches no host prototype, and a value born outside a concurrent branch cannot be written inside it. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: a record answers the host prototype for a name it does not own
mutations.find: return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop) ? (obj as Record<string, unknown>)[prop] : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: a host prototype is not reachable through a record
mutations.completionMarker: ok a member outside the table on an array is L4014, with the table in the message
mutations.cell: a host prototype is not reachable through a record
mutations.note: The pre-existing hole: `o.constructor`, `o.hasOwnProperty` and `o.toString` were host functions, and calling one with the interpreter's `(frame, args)` convention raised a raw TypeError with no L-code and no frame.

mutations.name: the birth-depth check is dropped, so an aliased outer value is writable inside a branch
mutations.expectRed: a value born outside a concurrent branch and written inside it, through an alias, is L2032
mutations.completionMarker: ok a fresh local record and array may be written; a value that crossed an effect boundary may not (L2031)
mutations.cell: a value born outside a concurrent branch and written inside it, through an alias, is L2032
mutations.note: The static L2032 walk cannot see a write through an alias (`const local = acc; local.a = 1`), so the runtime half is the only door on that path.

mutations.name: the interpreter's SwitchStatement case is renamed, so a node the table admits has no case
mutations.expectRed: every admitted node type has a case in the interpreter
mutations.completionMarker: ok the table's sets are disjoint
mutations.cell: every admitted node type has a case in the interpreter
mutations.note: The parity check reads the interpreter's source: an admitted node type without a `case` is exactly the drift this table exists to end (`x++`, `?.`, `**` were admitted by the validator and refused at run time). `switch` is chosen because no cell upstream of the parity check executes one; renaming a case an earlier cell exercises would redden that cell first and grade WRONG-RED in this fail-fast suite.

mutations.name: the computed-key guard is dropped, so host ToPrimitive runs a program closure again
mutations.expectRed: a computed member key that is a record, array, or function is L4018, catchable, on write and read
mutations.cell: a computed member key that is a record, array, or function is L4018, catchable, on write and read
mutations.note: No completionMarker on purpose: under this mutant the cell's LAST conjunct (the toString-closure read) can kill the process after the named red prints, and a marker would grade that KILLED run INCONCLUSIVE. The cell's conjuncts are ordered so the silent write-mint shape reds FIRST and short-circuits before any closure is invoked, so the red is clean; the crash shape exists in the cell only to pin the live behavior under the fix.
